C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 5. 43
Date 1 - 9 - 16 Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

31st August 1916

Sir,
It is reported that Han Hwe 韩恢 , the rebel officer who now calls himself the leader of the Labour Party in Shanghai, has offered to negotiate between the master painters and their employees who are now on strike.
Han Hwe yesterday sent his card to the master painters guild inviting it to send representatives to call on him.

General Tsai Ao of Yunnan arrived here on 29th instant and is staying with Mr. Hardoon, No. 181 Bubbling Well Road. Several prominent persons in Shanghai are planning to hold a public demonstration to welcome him.

Two of the Manchu Restoration party named Moh Zung Zen 馬攻善 and Ji San 刘三 were arrested at Lo Ka Pang 陸家浜 , Nantao, on 30th inst and are at present detained at Loongwha.

It is reported that representatives of the Japanese Consulate and the members of the Chapel Police searched the home of a Japanese in Da Tuh Li 大德里 Chapel on 30th inst and found 32 bombs. The occupier of the house was out when the search was made.

Your obedient servant,
McMurdo Strang
Chief Detective Inspector.

K. S. /8.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

Endorsed on 31st aug. 31.

刑事调查处
情报登记
编号 5.43
日期 1916年9月1日 上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年8月31日

先生：

据报，叛军军官韩恢（Han Hwe），现自称为上海劳工党领袖，提出在目前正在罢工的画匠师傅与其雇员之间进行调停。
韩恢昨日向画匠公会递送名片，邀请该会派代表拜访他。

云南蔡锷将军于本月29日抵沪，现寓居静安寺路181号哈同（Hardoon）先生宅邸。上海数位知名人士正计划举行公开示威活动以欢迎他。

两名满清复辟党成员，名为马攻善（Moh Zung Zen）和刘三（Ji San），于本月30日在南市陆家浜（Lo Ka Pang）被捕，目前拘押于龙华。

据报，日本领事馆代表及小巡捕房警员于本月30日搜查了大德里（Da Tuh Li）小巡捕房内一名日本人的住所，查获炸弹32枚。搜查时，该房屋居住者外出不在。

您忠实的仆人，
麦克默多·斯特兰（McMurdo Strang）
首席侦探督察长。

K. S. /8.
警务处总监。

批注于8月31日。
